title: wugs op envelope, schema 1
description: One line of a wugs op log (log/<scope>/<device>.jsonl), as specified in DATA-MODEL.md section 2.2 and 2.3 in this package. Licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT.

id.description: Op id: 'op_' + ULID. Unique, never reused.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock: wall millis (hex), counter (hex), device id. Lexicographic order is the total order of ops.

txn.description: Transaction id shared by every op one domain intent emitted. Txns apply atomically.

intent.description: Human-readable domain intent that produced the txn, e.g. 'split-morph'.

actor.description: Person id of the researcher who made the edit.

device.description: Device that authored the op; also the log file name.

scope.description: Sync and access scope: a source or text id, or one of 'lexicon', 'project', 'people'.

schema.description: Schema version this op was written under. Older versions are reinterpreted at replay, never rewritten.

op.description: Primitive verb. create: value is the initial field map. set: one field, last-writer-wins by hlc. delete/restore: tombstone flag only. text-edit: collaborative text field.

target.description: Id of the entity the op writes.

field.description: Field name for set and text-edit ops.

value.description: Field value (set), initial field map (create), or a text-edit payload.

base.description: Hlc of the field value this write overwrote (the winner the writer saw); null or absent if unset.

heads.description: Hlcs of every open version of the field the writer had: the winner plus unresolved conflict heads, like a merge commit's parents. Absent means [base], or none when base is null or absent. A field version no write names is open; two open versions that are not both merged text-edits are a conflict.

resolved.description: Full plain text after the edit. Authoritative for every reader.

loro.description: Optional Loro CRDT update, used only to merge concurrent edits. May be stripped from sealed archives.
